system: Milan System for Reporting Salivary Gland Cytopathology

milan_i_non_diagnostic.patientTitle: The sample was not enough for a clear diagnosis
milan_i_non_diagnostic.plainLanguageSummary: The salivary gland sample did not contain enough useful material for a clear diagnosis.
milan_i_non_diagnostic.whatThisMeans: This does not mean cancer was found. It means the sample was not adequate enough to provide a reliable answer.
milan_i_non_diagnostic.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend repeat sampling, imaging review, or further assessment depending on the lump and clinical findings.
milan_i_non_diagnostic.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

milan_ii_non_neoplastic.plainLanguageSummary: The sample shows non-tumor changes, such as inflammatory or benign reactive changes.
milan_ii_non_neoplastic.whatThisMeans: This result does not show a salivary gland tumor in the sample examined.
milan_ii_non_neoplastic.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend clinical or imaging follow-up, especially if the swelling persists or changes.
milan_ii_non_neoplastic.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

milan_iii_aus.professionalLabel: Milan Category III: Atypia of Undetermined Significance (AUS)
milan_iii_aus.plainLanguageSummary: The sample shows some cells that look unusual, but the findings are not enough to classify the lesion clearly.
milan_iii_aus.whatThisMeans: This is an indeterminate result. It may be due to benign changes, but further assessment may be needed.
milan_iii_aus.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend repeat FNA, imaging correlation, or specialist review.
milan_iii_aus.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

milan_iva_benign_neoplasm.plainLanguageSummary: The sample is most consistent with a benign, non-cancerous salivary gland tumor.
milan_iva_benign_neoplasm.whatThisMeans: Benign tumors are not cancer, but some may continue to grow or require removal depending on type, size, and symptoms.
milan_iva_benign_neoplasm.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend surgical consultation, imaging follow-up, or removal depending on the clinical situation.
milan_iva_benign_neoplasm.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

milan_ivb_sump.professionalLabel: Milan Category IVb: Salivary Gland Neoplasm of Uncertain Malignant Potential (SUMP)
milan_ivb_sump.patientTitle: Salivary gland tumor with uncertain behavior
milan_ivb_sump.plainLanguageSummary: The sample shows a salivary gland tumor, but cytology alone cannot confidently determine whether it is benign or malignant.
milan_ivb_sump.whatThisMeans: Further evaluation is usually needed to understand the exact nature of the tumor.
milan_ivb_sump.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend surgical consultation, excision, or additional tests if available.
milan_ivb_sump.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

milan_v_suspicious_for_malignancy.professionalLabel: Milan Category V: Suspicious for Malignancy
milan_v_suspicious_for_malignancy.plainLanguageSummary: The sample shows changes that are suspicious for cancer, but may not be sufficient for a definite diagnosis.
milan_v_suspicious_for_malignancy.whatThisMeans: There is significant concern, and further evaluation is usually needed.
milan_v_suspicious_for_malignancy.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend surgical consultation, additional sampling, imaging, or other tests.
milan_v_suspicious_for_malignancy.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

milan_vi_malignant.patientTitle: Cancer cells identified in the salivary gland sample
milan_vi_malignant.plainLanguageSummary: The sample shows malignant cells, meaning cancer cells were identified.
milan_vi_malignant.whatThisMeans: This result usually requires specialist assessment and treatment planning.
milan_vi_malignant.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor will likely arrange referral, imaging, surgery, or other treatment planning depending on the cancer type and extent.
milan_vi_malignant.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.
